Native-safe adaptations summary: react-i18next -> English-fallback hook (every key preserved); lucide Navigation/Car/Settings/Activity -> SemanticIcon navigation/vehicle/settings/activity glyphs tinted cyan-300/neon-purple/neon-amber/neon-cyan; useUnits().unitPrefs.speed + convertSpeedFromSI + fmtNumber -> useNativeUnits over useSettings (inline NIST-factor speed math + toLocaleString with the same precision/locale derivation); formatTime/cleanNil/parseSettingEnum -> inline value-identical ports; web GlassPanel/MetricCard -> native GlassPanel + inline MetricCard; framer-motion FadeIn -> static wrapper (reduced-motion final state); Recharts AreaChart stack -> native AreaChartWrapper; Leaflet MapContainer/tiles/Marker/Polyline/MapLayerSwitcher -> self-contained native LocationMap (canvas + tested route geometry for the trail/marker + native MapStyle switcher preserving mapStyle/setMapStyle); the interactive map/tiles/zoom/hover-tooltip are the only browser-only behaviours and are explicitly collapsed into static native surfaces. No DOM, no lucide-react, no Recharts, no Leaflet/react-leaflet, no framer-motion, and no web UI components imported.
